pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pMounted energy display for the adjacent face of an FE-compatible block.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Use the Calculator Screen item on a horizontal face of an energy block.$p2. Read that face’s stored energy and capacity.$p3. Recheck the target capability when rotating or replacing the block.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pThis is a display, not a battery, converter or power cable.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
